title: PrestaShop Redesign
meta: A fresh, faster design for your PrestaShop store that keeps every product and page address. From $250, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Redesign your PrestaShop store without losing rankings
overview: We redesign how your PrestaShop store looks and works, without changing your products or page addresses. After a short review of your shop and a design direction agreed with you, we rebuild the home page, category listings and product pages on a duplicate of your store. You approve the preview, then we switch it on. Your catalog, links and customer accounts stay exactly as they are.

faq: No. We change how pages look, not where they live. Page addresses, titles and descriptions stay the same unless you ask us to change them.
Do I need to bring a design?
No. We suggest a direction based on your brand and examples you like. If you already have design files, we follow them.
We test every installed module on the new design. Where a module's output clashes, we adjust the styling or tell you which module needs replacing.
Is this the same as buying a new theme?
Not quite. A new theme is a starting point. A redesign is tailored to your products and brand, and we also move your content blocks to fit.
